p.src: 1  To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

ja: よ、私に対して耳を閉ざさないでください。 あなたが私に
っておられるなら、 私は
たちのようになってしまう。
en: To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
u.src: 1  To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

p.src: 2  Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

ja: めるとき、願いの声を聞いてください。 あなたの至
en: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
u.src: 2  Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

p.src: 3  Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

ja: を抱く、不義を行う者たちと共に。
en: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
u.src: 3  Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

p.src: 4  Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

ja: って与え、 受けるべき報いを
en: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
u.src: 4  Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

p.src: 5  Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

en: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
u.src: 5  Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

p.src: 6  Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

ja: がほめたたえられますように。
en: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
u.src: 6  Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

p.src: 7  The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

ja: けられた。 それゆえ、私の
en: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
u.src: 7  The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

p.src: 8  The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

en: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
u.src: 8  The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

p.src: 9  Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

ja: い、 あなたの受け継ぐ民を
してください。 また、彼らの羊飼いとなり、 とこしえに
en: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
u.src: 9  Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
